title: What your customers see
summary: How someone claims your Tikka, from opening your link to showing their code at your counter.

steps.title: They open your link
steps.body: They see a sealed Tikka with your name on it and what's inside the drop, like "2 legendary · 10 rare · 88 thank-you". They tap to tear it open and see your card.

steps.title: They claim on WhatsApp
steps.body: They tap Claim, type their first name and continue on WhatsApp. WhatsApp opens with a message ready; they send it. That's how Tikka knows their number. They don't need an app or an account.

steps.title: They flip their Tikka
steps.body:
Back on the page, they hold to open and the card flips to show what they got: legendary, rare or thank-you. Every Tikka holds something.

Their card, with its code, also arrives in their WhatsApp.

steps.title: They come to you
steps.body: They show the code or QR at your counter, and you or your staff check it on the Redeem screen. Tikka reminds them on WhatsApp before their Tikka ends.

tips: People can claim from anywhere in Nigeria and visit you before their Tikka ends.
Each WhatsApp number gets one Tikka per drop. Claiming again sends the same card.
